acceptance: Red-first: a gc run with a cache over the cap frees it and reports the bytes; under the cap it does nothing.
The wave preflight refuses to start below the free-space floor, naming the floor and the free bytes.
100% coverage on each changed function; zero code comments; the gc and preflight docs name the keys.
fix: Give gc a size cap for the Go build cache in policy (for example gc.go_build_cache_max_gb, default 40): when the cache is over the cap, gc runs go clean -cache (or trims the oldest entries) at the boundary and reports the bytes freed. Add a free-space check to the wave preflight that halts with a clear code (for example HOST_DISK_LOW) below a policy floor, before lanes start.

source: console 2026-11-03 23:30: evolve ci classify failed with 'no space left on device'; df showed 273 MB free of 460 GB; ~/Library/Caches/go-build held 138 GB; go clean -cache freed 139 GB
summary: evolve gc lists 'go build cache entries' in its scope, yet the Go build cache grew to 138 GB across waves (many worktrees, race and cover builds, integration tags). A full disk breaks the loop, git, the builds and the CI classifier at once, with errors that do not name the cause.
title: evolve gc keeps the Go build cache under a size cap; the host reached 273 MB free with a 138 GB cache
